title: When is it safe to shrink?
hook: A qualifying window may still contain a shorter answer.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Find a shortest positive-sum window by shrinking only after the threshold is met.

misconception: Finding a shortest qualifying interval requires checking all starts independently.
objective: Find a shortest positive-sum window by shrinking only after the threshold is met.

claims.text: Positivity makes extension increase the sum and shrinking decrease it. Once a window qualifies, moving its left edge explores shorter candidates; negative entries would break this monotone justification.
